title: Hearing the Order: Investigating Position Bias in Large Audio-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Systematically reassigning the correct answer to different option positions (A, B, C, and D) in multiple-choice questions while randomly shuffling the remaining options, and measuring performance fluctuations using Delta Accuracy, Relative Standard Deviation (RSD), and Choice Kullback-Leibler Divergence (CKLD).
